{{Top|leg|title=''FarStar'' starfighter squadron}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Citation}}
This '''starfighter squadron''' was assigned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''. It was commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ranna Gorjaye]], and included [[Noell Ciro]] and [[Dasha Defano]] among its personnel.

It consisted of eight [[T-65B_X-wing_starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-Wing Starfighters]] and four [[Defender starfighter|Defender Starfighters]].
